title: Simple corporate website from one paragraph
note: Mechanism only: brief -> NEW_WEBSITE/CORPORATE_WEBSITE. A live end-to-end build is not run here.

title: Premium product website
note: Needs a live design + build run; judged by humans against the design standards.

title: E-commerce website
note: Mechanism only: classified as E_COMMERCE. Live build not run.

title: Authenticated customer portal
note: Mechanism only: classified as CUSTOMER_PORTAL. Live build not run.

title: Full-stack website with database
note: Mechanism only: classified as FULL_STACK_MVP. Live build not run.

title: Website redesign
note: Guard only: refuses without an existing project, accepts with one. Live redesign not run.

title: Existing project enhancement
note: Guard only: refuses without an existing project, accepts with one. Live enhancement not run.

title: Performance regression detected
note: Ratchet mechanism (shared by all measured metrics). A real regression on a real site is not simulated.

title: Accessibility failure detected
note: Ratchet mechanism incl. axe violations. A real a11y failure on a real site is not simulated.

title: Subscription usage limit approached
note: Context/turn budget circuit breaker only. Claude Pro subscription usage cannot be read programmatically, so real usage limits are not detected.

title: Production deployment approval required
note: Approval is required by instructions (commands, CLAUDE.md) but is not mechanically enforced: no hook blocks a production deploy command. Recorded as a known gap.
